environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed as part of a Step Functions workflow for OAuth callback processing. Lambda runs in default VPC with full internet access. IAM role has secretsmanager:GetSecretValue permission. The token_endpoint_url parameter is passed directly from API Gateway without transformation. No VPC endpoints configured - Lambda can reach any IP including 169.254.169.254. Secrets rotation Lambda runs on a separate schedule but rotation interval is configured to 3600s (1 hour) in production due to cost concerns, not 60s as the code suggests.

config.api_gateway: REST API with no request validation template
config.step_functions: Standard workflow, no input filtering on task states
config.network: No VPC endpoints, full outbound internet via NAT/IGW
config.imds_version: IMDSv1 enabled on any EC2 reachable via SSRF
